# Genuine original schema4 review history oracle

This JSON was extracted once from the frozen original M6.2-A compiled schema4 services before any M6.3 compilation. It is not schema5 data with a changed version label. Provenance and exact code hashes are in `docs/reviews/2026-10-09-m6-3-a/verification/old-schema4-review-runtime-manifest.json` and the narrow original blob-helper supplement. The extraction receipt and complete safe stdout/stderr are retained in the same verification directory.

The trusted synthetic seed creates four human actors, a private WAL SQLite database, one space/thread and one public claim through the original PostService. Original ReviewRequestService produces cancelled, empty-collecting, partially sealed and revealed requests. Original ReviewSubmissionService produces three exact acknowledgements and sealed/revealed read objects. Original ArtifactService and frozen ArtifactFileStore publish three real private files: sealed cited, revealed cited and revealed unused. Original reader privacy refusal for sealed and unused evidence and each physical SHA/length are checked during extraction. All owned database/blob files are removed in finally.

The JSON contains only synthetic research/history rows; credentials and instance secret are excluded. Tests must mint independent private credentials and private instance metadata after loading. `rows` covers original migrations, actors/space/revisions/memberships/sessions, thread/posts, artifacts, six formal tables, typed idempotency refs and events. `physical_artifacts` gives public synthetic UTF-8 recipe bytes for reconstructing only these private fixture files; use each `artifacts.storage_key`, verify SHA/length and keep files in an owned test directory.

`oracle.requests[]` contains scenario, original actor/space/key/payload, exact base create response, exact raw compact reference, and independent current read response. `oracle.cancel` stores the true original cancel payload/confirmation/ref. `oracle.submissions[]` stores exact original submit acknowledgements/ref/payload. `oracle.assignment_reads`, `oracle.submission_reads`, `oracle.revealed_artifact_read` and `oracle.uploads[]` preserve their actual original views. Create/cancel base confirmations have no count; current reads include actual count and sealed changed_by=null. Replays are checked with strict deepEqual, not by inserting future fields. This fixture enables normal regression without executing an old whole runtime or relying on deleted temporary databases.

SHA of JSON: `6723085899305599a991905edf65aa226a983103c43e4fafdb6ad85ade0bc6ab`; 70,588 bytes. It establishes limited genuine old4 API/history evidence, not an old deployed-system certification or real research assessment.
